stem:
The diagram shows Trisha's variegated leaf before the iodine test. Region G is green and region W is non-green. Leaf A stayed in sunlight. Leaf B was all green and stayed in the dark. Green colour is removed before iodine is added.

Answer both parts.

parts.text: Where should the blue-black starch result appear?

options.text: Only in region G of Leaf A.
In the green tissue of Leaf B as well as in region G of Leaf A.
In both region G and region W of Leaf A.
Only in region W of Leaf A.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Starch forms in green tissue that received sunlight, so only region G of Leaf A should turn blue-black.

teacher.key_rationale: Detectable starch needs green chlorophyll-containing tissue plus sunlight. Dark-kept green leaf and non-green patches should not show the blue-black result.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote glucose equation tikz into variegated Leaf A (G/W) and dark Leaf B.
